description: Convert markdown into a designed PDF (cover page, auto TOC, page-numbered footer). Use this for any "save/export/print/share as PDF", "make a report", "turn this into a PDF", or /pdf request — do NOT fall back to Chrome headless, cupsfilter, wkhtmltopdf, pandoc, or LaTeX. Templates: research-report (cover + TOC, default) or plain (no cover, no TOC).

author.description: Author name shown on the cover page.

content.description: Markdown content to convert to PDF.

output_path.description: Absolute path for the output PDF. Defaults to ~/Documents/pdf-it/{title}-{timestamp}.pdf

template.description: Template to use. "research-report" (default) adds a cover page and table of contents. "plain" renders body content only.

title.description: Document title shown on the cover page and footer.

name: generate_pdf
title: Generate PDF
